soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 (thm:certificate-soundness)
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem merely unpacks facts that def:lc-verifier explicitly checks—model membership, equal observed cells, unequal query, and residual identity—then applies the definition of nonidentification, so it contributes no substantive mathematical step as currently stated.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 5 states termination and correctness when Algorithm 1 returns an expression; Theorem 6 states that identification in every context-specific DAG need not imply identification in the original CSI problem.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 4, Theorem 1; pp. 5–6, Algorithm 1 and Corollary 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 assumes controls C are observed roots, maximal-regular labels, and gives an iff reduction to every control-context graph; Corollary 2 calls the resulting procedure sound and complete.

The cited UAI paper exists and concerns state-based effects with CSI constraints. The theorem text was corroborated only in arXiv:2510.16703v3, pp. 4–6, where Algorithm 1 is sound when it returns a formula and complete only when constraints are empty; no version-sensitive mismatch flag is asserted.

The paper proves a sound-and-complete c-gID procedure under explicitly added positivity, for arbitrary conditional effects with observational and/or interventional Q-distributions; it is a distinct information regime from the proposed CSI-completeness target.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace Theorem 3 with a supporting verifier-implementation lemma, or strengthen it to a non-definitional extraction theorem proving that a substantially smaller syntactic certificate implies global shared-row realizability without rechecking the complete observed-law and query polynomials verbatim.

State explicitly that each CSI context is an assignment to observed parent variables of the affected child, and formalize the strict inclusion over Mokhtarian et al.'s observed-root-control class with the displayed endogenous-parent instance as the separating witness.

Make the central OEQ’s prospective completeness theorem require a formally specified trace grammar and a semantic completeness equivalence over the full constrained model class, so the finite bound B(s) bounds a defined search space rather than an eventual completion of the handle.

recommended_next_step: Revise this angle by removing the definitional certificate-soundness theorem from the claimed mathematical kernel and sharpening the endogenous-observed-context regime and prospective completeness contract; retain the field-tier global-dichotomy OEQ.
